title: Anthropic polled 1,334 of its employees. They're more sure than most of us that AI will take over jobs.
summary:
Anthropic employees believe that AI will make their labor obsolete.
The AI company published research on Friday that compares surveys with US adults against an internal poll of 1,334 Anthropic employees.
Anthropic workers are far more optimistic about the progress of AI capabilities, how much it's already saving time, and how fast the economy will grow.
Anthropic workers expect higher unemployment and extreme GDP growthAnthropic's surveys examined how workers already use AI and how they think it will change.
Anthropic employees have larger budgets for the tools and often get access to unreleased models.

summary:
'Twas the week of big bank earnings, and Wall Street had a new threat on its mind: rogue AI.
Executives at the country's largest financial institutions used their earnings calls to assure investors that they are doing everything in their power to fend off attacks from powerful, rogue AI models.
Later in the call, she said that Citigroup was continuing to "invest in leading-edge capabilities" to strengthen its cyber defenses.

title: Volvo will use Nvidia’s tech for hands-free, point-to-point driving
summary:
Volvo plans to launch hands-free, point-to-point driving by 2030, powered by Nvidia’s latest AI technology.
The Chinese-owned, Swedish-designed automaker said Thursday it would use Nvidia’s autonomous driving stack to power a new partially automated driving system similar to Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (Supervised).
Volvo says the new point-to-point system will be Level 2++, meaning it can handle complex urban environments, including traffic lights, stop signs, and unprotected left turns without explicit driver control.
The automaker had to effectively sideline its Ride Pilot Level 3 unsupervised autonomous driving system in the US after failing to obtain regulatory approval.
Volvo plans to make the new point-to-point driving system available across its vehicle lineup, from entry-level to high-end versions — though the company didn’t reveal which models will come first.

title: Norrsken and Nvidia to open Stockholm AI Lab for founders in 2027
summary:
Norrsken Foundation and Nvidia will open a hub for AI startups in central Stockholm in 2027.
The Stockholm AI Lab will host a select group of European founders who use AI to address problems in climate, health, food and society, and it will also be home to Nvidia’s Stockholm office.
The project follows a pledge Norrsken made in June 2025, when it set aside a €300M AI fund for European startups using AI for social and environmental good.
Earlier this week, chief executive Jensen Huang said the company would put a further $2bn into European AI companies.
Besides Stockholm, Norrsken runs houses in Barcelona, Kigali, Brussels and Amsterdam, and its five funds have raised more than $1bn.

He said that when people have to choose between shutting down data centers or shutting down ChatGPT, it won't be an easy decision.

title: Google is making inline links more prominent in AI responses
summary:
Google is updating its AI search results to make inline links appear “higher up in responses more frequently,” according to a blog post.
The company’s search results from AI Overviews and AI Mode give you answers in a customized view instead of the traditional list of links, but there are concerns that the format reduces traffic to publishers.
Google is making links at the end of a query “more engaging and prominent, with image thumbnails and a more clickable design.” And it’s now testing clickable links in AI mode to search profiles for publishers and creators.
An image from Google showing relevant links to a query about getting a refund.

summary:

title: An Entire Swedish TV Show Got Deleted, and AI Got Blamed
summary:
A TV4 system failure wiped out hundreds of hours of work, and Sweden’s Aftonbladet newspaper reported that an AI agent was at fault, citing unnamed sources at the production company, called Mastiff.
The Swedish series was due to return on Nov. 22, but has been delayed indefinitely, TV4 said in a statement.
The TV4 network denies the Aftonbladet report that an AI agent deleted the episodes.
“We don’t have the exact details of what happened yet, but it’s not true that this was caused by an AI agent.
While TV4 said an AI agent was not to blame, it did not clarify whether another type of AI might have had some role in the deletion.

title: KPMG Survey: CEOs Share AI Impacts on Hiring and Training
summary:
Leaders of big US companies say AI agents are starting to produce gains, yet few report that the technology is fundamentally reshaping their businesses.
KPMG US released a survey on Thursday of 400 CEOs of major US-based companies.
About four in 10 said AI agents had delivered significant improvements in efficiency or growth, while a similar share reported moderate effects in targeted uses.
The survey signaled that CEOs don't see the technology simply as a tool for trimming payrolls.
About eight in 10 CEOs said AI had prompted their organizations to reconsider how they develop employees.

summary:

summary:

The FBI arrested Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old from Saudi Arabia, on Friday, Oct. 9, after a complaint was filed against him.

summary:
